Thief (Sequence 9): gain 1 Purification Energy each turn.
Swindler (Sequence 8): gain 20 true Gold each turn; Counterfeit Gold is not used.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits Sequence 9.
Cryptologist (Sequence 7): every 2 turns randomly trigger one incomplete Eureka or Inspiration.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.

Prometheus (Sequence 6): each turn copy 10% of current Production in all producing cities of other major civilizations to your Capital queue; sources are not reduced.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.

Dream Stealer (Sequence 5): each turn copy 10% of other major civilizations' positive Science, Culture and Faith yields directly to your values; sources are not reduced.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.

Parasite (Sequence 4): the pathway holder can found an advanced city on its current legal founding tile, with 3 additional Population and Ancient Walls; after use, the holder dies and revives 5 turns later.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.

Mentor of Deceit (Sequence 3): ordinary Rampagers attacking any civilization or City-State unit or city have a 33% chance to deal no damage and reflect 100% of simulated damage back; Outer Gods and minions are immune.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.
Fate Trojan (Sequence 2): once copy up to 3 portable abilities from other major civilizations; sources are not reduced.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.

Worm of Time (Sequence 1): gain a Time Worm in your Capital. It has 10 Movement, costs no population, can found cities without disappearing, and has a 3-turn cooldown after each founding. Founded cities belong to you and receive 3 additional Population and Ancient Walls.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.

Error (Sequence 0): each world turn randomly erase one fifth of ordinary uncontrolled Workshops and Rampagers (at least one), with normal Purification credit; Outer Gods and minions are excluded.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Inherits higher Sequences.
